kopi.tekst: function fmtCell(v,type){ if(v==null||v==='')return ''; if(type==='kr')return fmtKr(v); if(type==='kr0')return fmtNum(Math.round(v)); if(type==='pct')return fmtPct(v); if(type==='num')return fmtNum(v); if(type==='date')return fmtDY(v); return String(v);}

function downloadBlob(blob,name){ const u=URL.createObjectURL(blob); const a=document.createElement('a'); a.href=u; a.download=name; document.body.appendChild(a); a.click(); a.remove(); setTimeout(()=>URL.revokeObjectURL(u),1500); }
